derivation: Simple Arrows' arrows are crafted from cheap materials four at a time like Vanilla's arrow (the Silver Arrow was not sold in Simple Ores either, the Fletching Table's arrows were not sold in SimpleBuilding); nothing is sold.

excluded.simplearrows:light_arrow: Crafted ammunition (glowstone dust, stick, feather); built, not bought.
excluded.simplearrows:silver_arrow: Crafted ammunition (silver nugget, stick, feather); built, not bought.
excluded.simplearrows:crafted_arrow: Fletching Table ammunition (tip, shaft, fletching); built at the table, not bought.
excluded.simplearrows:guide_book: Old guide book; turns into the Simple Modpack guide.
